# THE INTEGER-ASSIGNMENT CORPUS (F-098, F-099): write-refusal rows that set a
# TortureCook integer, on every path a row takes to one, to a value past its
# declared kind, with the value at each end of the range beside it. A driver
# manifest (testdata/conformance/tables/FORMAT.md, the derived form: no
# verdict); answers.txt holds what a driver owes for each case. The Java
# driver answers it in
# internal/codegen/javatable/conformance_writerefusal_int_test.go, and the
# harness's Go engine in test/conformance/harness/writerefusal_test.go
# (TestWriteRefusalEngineHoldsTheIntCorpus), where `refused` and
# `unrepresentable` are the one verdict, as the harness scores them.
unit cooktorture test/tables/cooktorture/CookTorture.schema
# a scalar field
write-refusal i32_past_max      cooktorture TortureCook testdata/conformance/tables/wire/torture_cook_extremes.bin b_i32                int 2147483648
write-refusal i32_max           cooktorture TortureCook testdata/conformance/tables/wire/torture_cook_extremes.bin b_i32                int 2147483647
